Kerala MP John Brittas Alleges Manhandling by Delhi Police

Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas has alleged that Delhi Police manhandled him, pinning him under a bus seat and dropping him by the roadside. Brittas, who is from Kerala, claimed the police showed no respect for the Supreme Court. The CPI(M) also stated that the Delhi Police had crossed all limits.
